name: Gilbey's London Dry Gin
owner: Diageo (brand owner), produced under long-term licence by Jim Beam Brands
history: 1857 | Walter and Alfred Gilbey, back from the Crimean War, set up a wine importing business in Soho
1867 | Business moved to the Pantheon building, Oxford Street
1872 | Gin distillery opened in Camden Town (approx.)
1895 | Gin called Gilbey's since this year (The Gin is In)
1920s | Gin distilleries in Australia and Canada
1930s | US distilling rights sold; distilled in the US since
notes: 12 botanicals stated but not listed. Prohibition-era counterfeiting led to square bottles sandblasted on three sides; Wyvern on label. Tasting notes from Difford's reviewer (2012). Backlog owner 'nhiều chủ sở hữu' – sources say Diageo owns, Jim Beam licensed [cần kiểm tra].
